title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 192
paragraphs: The storm had ceased on the fourth day; meanwhile, the day-watchers had run down from the heights of Euboea on the day after the first storm began, and were keeping the Greeks informed of everything that had happened with the shipwreck. On learning this, the Greeks first prayed to Poseidon the Savior and poured libations, then hurried back to Artemisium, expecting that only very few enemy ships would be left to come against them.
